HOW TO USE IT

Creatine, the simple way

{{ first_name|default:'there' }}, a quick guide so your creatine works as hard
as you do.

How much: 3–5g a day, every day, including rest days. No loading phase needed.
When: any time; with a meal or your shake is easiest.
Patience: strength and power gains build over 3–4 weeks. Drink plenty of
water.

General guidance, not medical advice. Follow the label and speak to your
doctor if you have a medical condition.
